summary.name: Volumetric Fire & Smoke
summary.visualIdentity: Explicitly, emissive three-dimensional flame and translucent smoke are rendered as coherent volumes with readable depth, buoyant motion, cooling soot and light spill. The stage stays dark or contrasting, with bounded exposure and consistent camera scale. Flat glow sprites, liquid blobs and particle showers must not substitute for the volume.
summary.suitableUses: Explicitly, the style suits scenes centred on fire or smoke as a readable volume, such as ignition, tall flame and cooling smoke sequences. An optional explosion-aftermath recipe uses staged shock and debris. Inferred: it suits dramatic hero shots where depth and material weight matter. Physical accuracy is not established.
summary.limitations: The volume is an illustrative procedural approximation, not a combustion solver, and temperature colours are approximate rather than measured. Physically simulated full shots need Blender/Cycles gas simulation with baked frames, which is unavailable here and must be reported as missing. Internal rendering is bounded to about 640×360 upscaled, with at most 64 primary and 6 light steps. The background hex is an authored default, not source-verified.
summary.palette: These tokens are authored suggestions, and any task-approved exact colours take precedence. Background #101218 is for the scene field only. Foreground #F6EFE3 is the lightest hierarchy colour, and text contrast targets 4.5:1 on actual composited pixels. Coal #4B403A is for the hearth, flame_core #FFF0BC, flame_amber #FFAD42 and flame_orange #F05A28 are emission roles, and smoke #747B86 is for cooling smoke. Gradients are disabled.
summary.motionAndInteraction: Explicitly, a paused GSAP timeline sets time, ignition and cooling uniforms, and every seek redraws one frame. A three-second preview runs ignition from 0 to 0.6s, tall readable flame from 0.6 to 2.0s, and translucent cooling smoke from 2.0 to 3.0s. Buoyancy and curl are analytic functions of time with no feedback buffers. The blast recipe stages shock radius and debris, keeping causal propagation visible. User interaction is unspecified.
summary.audio: Audio is unspecified by the style source. The prompt suggests choosing task-appropriate music, ambience, voiceover or silence, and matching any combustion sound only to visible action. Honour provided audio and do not invent audio assets. Music mood, tempo, language and voice pace are unspecified. Keep speech intelligible, avoid clipping and competing vocals, and inspect audio with picture.
summary.assetRequirements: Explicitly, local fonts and assets must load before rendering, and the caption must state that the volume is an illustrative procedural approximation. Full physically simulated shots require baked volume or debris frame sequences, which are not available here. No motion-reference candidates are supplied, so restrained style-native motion applies. Other external assets are unspecified.
summary.combinations: Keep Volumetric Fire & Smoke dominant. Style-061 may supply grounded environmental illumination, and style-105 may supply measured visual and audio event timing. Supporting styles should keep the primary material and background roles and share one coordinate and timing system. Avoid competing full-frame treatments and invented measurements. These are compatibility suggestions, not restrictions.
summary.productionApproach: The style renderer is raw WebGL2 with GLSL fragment raymarching, and it owns volume, lighting and palette. The motion engine is GSAP, with one owner per animated property. HyperFrames is the default render pipeline for timing, validation, snapshots and export. Remotion is a fallback only when HyperFrames is unavailable or a verified limitation exists, and the reason must be recorded. chroma.js is optional for palette and contrast checks.
